EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, TIMING OFF, FORMAT JSON) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(category) = 0 THEN 'category'
            WHEN GROUPING(region) = 0 THEN 'region' ELSE 'year' END AS dimension,
       COALESCE(category, region, (2000 + 5 * ((year - 2000) / 5))::text) AS bucket,
       count(*)
FROM field_notes_500000 WHERE year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2024 AND search_vector @@ to_tsquery('english', 'habitat & (wetland | marsh) & !invasive')
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((category), (region), (2000 + 5 * ((year - 2000) / 5)))
ORDER BY 1, 2

Sort Key: (CASE WHEN (GROUPING(category) = 0) THEN 'category'::text WHEN (GROUPING(region) = 0) THEN 'region'::text ELSE 'year'::text END)
